old: This master file merges the two companion batches — CGHS (the scheme for the ~80 CGHS-covered cities) and CS(MA) Rules, 1944 (the statutory rules for non-CGHS areas) — into a single document with zero content omitted from either source file. Both batches were independently fact-checked against primary MoHFW/DoPT/DoE sources before merging (see the verification notices retained inside each section below). All DA-linked figures have been updated to reflect the current DA/DR rate of 63% (effective 1 July 2026 — confirmed by June-2026 CPI-IW; Cabinet approval & formal notification expected Sept–Oct 2026 with arrears from 01.07.2026); these are formula-based thresholds that move at every DA revision, so the computed rupee figures are flagged as dynamic, not final.
